hard_gates: All energies must be normalized per BaO formula unit.
A grid endpoint may not be reported as a transition pressure without refinement or uncertainty.
The two LOBSTER projections must use the same VASP wavefunction.
Spilling quality must be reported before interpreting ICOHP or PDOS.
native_layer_note: The current public LOBSTER Actions parse outputs. Generating new LOBSTER outputs requires the toolbox native-job layer until a dedicated run Action is added.
